verdict.rationale: Workbench ships an in-browser Shell with tab completion and a built-in API Explorer to "visually explore API resources and build API calls," and it executes real API requests against a sandbox. That is an interactive, runnable way to explore the API. Stripe also publishes OpenAPI spec files for tooling, though the docs-site OpenAPI paths returned 404. missing for 10: evidence that the public API reference docs themselves embed runnable examples (the explorer lives inside the Dashboard and requires an account/sandbox), independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
